# redux-retry

> Local async state and manual retry for Redux sagas and thunks.

The modern 1.x release uses npm's `next` channel. `latest` remains legacy `0.0.7`.
Install `redux-retry@next` or pin `redux-retry@1.0.0`.

- [Install and API guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nimeshgurung/redux-retry/master/llm.text): Markdown examples, supported versions, API contracts and consumer verification.
- [README](https://github.com/nimeshgurung/redux-retry#readme): Human documentation and runnable examples.
- [npm metadata](https://registry.npmjs.org/redux-retry): Check published versions before installing.
